description: The same Instance in Env A (left) and Env B (right): pg_stat_statements per query mask (pg_stmt_mask, top 200), masks of one env only and mean time changes. Click query_mask_md5 for the statement detail. Source: ClickHouse pg_monitoring (dual write).

panels.description: share_pct = share of the env total exec time: the load differs between envs, compare the shares. Per query mask (IN-lists / VALUES collapsed), summed over users, increase over the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT *, total_ms / nullIf(sum(total_ms) OVER (), 0) AS share_pct FROM (SELECT datname, query_mask_md5, s_total_ms AS total_ms, s_calls AS calls, s_total_ms / nullIf(s_calls, 0) AS mean_ms, s_rows AS rows, query_mask FROM (SELECT datname, query_mask_md5, sum(total_ms) AS s_total_ms, sum(calls) AS s_calls, sum(rows) AS s_rows FROM (SELECT datname, usename, query_mask_md5, c_total_ms AS total_ms, c_calls AS calls, c_rows AS rows FROM (SELECT datname, usename, query_mask_md5, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(total_exec_time)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(total_exec_time)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_total_ms, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(calls)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(calls)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_calls, arraySum(arrayMap((d, v) -> if(d < 0, v, d), arrayDifference(arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(rows)), groupArray(time))), arraySort((v, t) -> t, groupArray(toFloat64(rows)), groupArray(time)))) AS c_rows FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt_mask WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND env = ${env_a:singlequote} AND db_instance = ${db_instance:singlequote} AND $__conditionalAll(datname IN (${datname:singlequote}), $datname) GROUP BY datname, usename, query_mask_md5)) GROUP BY datname, query_mask_md5) AS s LEFT JOIN (SELECT query_mask_md5, argMax(query_mask, time) AS query_mask FROM pg_monitoring.pg_stmt_text WHERE env = ${env_a:singlequote} AND db_instance = ${db_instance:singlequote} GROUP BY query_mask_md5) AS t USING (query_mask_md5))
